records.fact: Mahan Air carried about 200 people, including senior Houthi officials, women and children, to Iran for Ayatollah Khamenei funeral according to Reuters source chain.

Yemen internationally recognized government claimed strikes on Sanaa airport runway to prevent an Iranian/Mahan aircraft from landing; Houthis blamed Saudi Arabia. Saudi communication office did not immediately comment in Reuters report.
records.status: AIRPORT_STRIKE_AND_STATED_PURPOSE_CONFIRMED; immediate Saudi unilateral attribution not established by that Reuters story

records.fact: Mahan flight diverted from Sanaa to Hodeidah after runway attack.

Four Reuters sources—including two Iranian sources, Yemen information minister and regional analyst—said July 13 Mahan flight carried 10-21 IRGC personnel including commanders/advisers plus missile/drone components; one analyst also reported gold. Iran/Houthis denied military aid/personnel and said flight repatriated delegation/patients.
records.status: MULTISOURCE_REPORT_WITH_OFFICIAL_DENIAL; not treated as independently visually proven cargo manifest

records.fact: HRW satellite analysis assessed Yemeni government forces in coalition with Saudi Arabia attacked Sanaa airport with at least five munitions, three hitting the only working runway; stated purpose was to prevent Mahan landing.
records.status: SATELLITE_CORROBORATED_STRIKE; coalition relationship supported; exact platform/crew attribution unresolved

adjudication: Do not compress this into Saudi Arabia admitted bombing the airport to stop IRGC commanders. The defensible chain is Yemeni-government claimed strike + Saudi coalition relationship + later multisource Reuters allegation about IRGC passengers/cargo + Iranian/Houthi denial.
